25.explanation: Harappan cities had no monumental stone temples. Lost-wax bronzes, steatite seals with animal motifs and abundant terracotta figurines are all typical.

26.explanation: The bronze Dancing Girl and the steatite Priest-King were both found at Mohenjodaro.

27.explanation: Many scholars identify the Ghaggar–Hakra with the Vedic Saraswati.

29.explanation: Rakhigarhi is in Haryana, Lothal in Gujarat, Mohenjodaro in Pakistan (Sindh) and Alamgirpur in Uttar Pradesh.

30.explanation: The right to be forgotten is not absolute. It gives way to legitimate public interest and is weighed against free speech.

31.explanation: Information still relevant to public interest and accountability is the weakest case for erasure.

32.explanation: Puttaswamy (2017), which recognised informational privacy under Art. 21, is the foundation of the right to be forgotten.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Puttaswamy v. Union of India

33.explanation: Courts have read the right to shelter into Art. 21 (e.g. Chameli Singh, 1996). It is not expressly listed in Part III.

sources.title: Chameli Singh v. State of U.P. (1996)

34.explanation: The DPDP Act, 2023 gives a right to correction and erasure (s.12) but does not expressly name a 'right to be forgotten'.

sources.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, Section 12

35.explanation: The Delhi High Court weighed open justice and transparency of court records against informational privacy.

36.explanation: El Niño begins when the easterly trade winds weaken and warm water moves east.

37.explanation: Upwelling of cold, nutrient-rich water (Humboldt Current) supports the rich Peruvian fisheries.

38.explanation: El Niño warms the eastern Pacific and can raise global temperatures, but it weakens the Walker Circulation rather than strengthening it.

39.explanation: Rice, a water-intensive kharif crop, is most exposed to a weak southwest monsoon. Wheat, mustard and barley are rabi crops.

40.explanation: The Oceanic Niño Index tracks sea-surface temperature anomalies in the Niño 3.4 region. The SOI measures pressure.

41.explanation: El Niño suppresses upwelling off Peru and Ecuador. El Niño Modoki has peak warming in the central Pacific. La Niña brings a cooler eastern Pacific.
